title_sq: Apartament ne shitje, 1+1 tek Rruga e Dibres !
description_sq:
Apartament ne shitje, 1+1 tek Rruga e Dibres per 96900 Euro!
- Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4, te nje rezidence qe po ndertohet se fundmi ne Rrugen e Dibres, prane QSUT, zone e cila te ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
- Ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 61m2, te organizuar ne nje nje sallon ndenje + ambientin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe ballkoni llozhe.
- Rezidenca aktualisht eshte ne ndertim e siper, dhe pritet te perfundoj se shpejti.
- Apartamenti eshte nje mundesi ideale qofte per banim ashtu edhe per investim, pasi zona eshte mjafte e kerkuar per facilitetet qe ofron, si dhe aksesin me rruget kryesore apo unazen e vogel te kryeqytetit.
title_en: Apartment for sale, 1+1 on Rruga e Dibre!
description_en: Apartment for sale, 1+1 on Rruga e Dibre for 96900 Euro! - The apartment is located on the 4th floor, of a residence that is being built recently on Dibre Street, near QSUT, an area that offers all the facilities for a comfortable life. - It has a total area of ​​61m2, organized in a living room + kitchen area, a bedroom, a toilet and a loggia balcony. - The residence is currently under construction and is expected to be completed soon. - The apartment is an ideal opportunity both for living and for investment, as the area is quite sought after for the facilities it offers, as well as access to the main roads or the small ring of the capital.
